subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-visible name should OpenClaw use for the `google-vertex` provider now that Google documents Vertex AI Platform as Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform?
rationale: The requested wording is not the official current Google Cloud name, and provider display copy should avoid confusing users whose config still uses `google-vertex`.

options.title: Use Official Transitional Wording
options.body: Rename display/docs copy to `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Google Vertex AI)` while preserving all `google-vertex` ids.

options.title: Use Short Official Name
options.body: Use `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform` in labels/docs and explain the stable `google-vertex` id only where needed.

options.title: Keep Vertex AI For Now
options.body: Leave the old public label until maintainers decide a broader provider/docs naming policy for Google Enterprise Agent Platform surfaces.

recommendation.title: Use Official Transitional Wording
recommendation.body: Rename display/docs copy to `Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (formerly Google Vertex AI)` while preserving all `google-vertex` ids.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent provider catalog/onboarding and provider contract history makes this the best available owner for the public naming choice.
